Standard fighter communication links are re-purposed to provide short-range targeting data.

Increases fighter damage to missiles and other fighters by %s, but makes the fighters unable to leave the vicinity of their ship.
defensive_targeting_array.short: Increases fighter PD damage, reduces fighter roam range to zero.

eccm.name: ECCM Package
eccm.desc:
Reduces the chance for missiles launched by the ship to be affected by electronic counter-measures and flares by %s.

A CPU core adjunct in each missile increases missile top speed by %s and missile maneuverability by %s, as well as significantly improving the guidance algorithm.

Also reduces the weapon range reduction due to enemy ECM by %s.
eccm.short: Improves missile speed and guidance, reduces effect of enemy Electronic Warfare.

ecm.name: ECM Package
ecm.desc: When deployed in combat, grants %s/%s/%s/%s ECM rating, depending on this ship's hull size.

escort_package.name: Escort Package
escort_package.desc:
When this ship is within approximately %s su of a larger friendly vessel, increases this ship's maneuverability by %s, and top speed by %s. Also increases ballistic and energy weapon range by %s.

These bonuses are %s for destroyers when the nearby friendly is a capital ship.
escort_package.short: Increases maneuverability, top speed, and weapon range when near larger friendly ship.

expanded_deck_crew.name: Expanded Deck Crew
expanded_deck_crew.desc:
Reduces the rate at which the fighter replacement rate decreases due to fighter losses by %s, and increases the rate at which it recovers by %s.

Increases the crew required by %s per fighter bay.
expanded_deck_crew.short: Improves fighter replacement rate, increases crew requirements.

magazines.name: Expanded Magazines
magazines.desc: Increases the ammo capacity or the number of charges for ballistic and energy weapons by %s.
magazines.short: Increases ammo/charges for ballistic and energy weapons.

missleracks.name: Expanded Missile Racks
missleracks.desc: Increases the ammo capacity of missile weapons by %s.

extendedshieldemitter.name: Extended Shields
extendedshieldemitter.desc: Increases the shield's coverage by %s degrees.

fluxcoil.name: Flux Coil Adjunct
fluxcoil.desc: Increases the ship's flux capacity by %s/%s/%s/%s, depending on hull size. Not as efficient as flux capacitors - most useful when added to a design that already carries the maximum possible number of capacitors.

fluxdistributor.name: Flux Distributor
fluxdistributor.desc: Increases the ship's flux dissipation by %s/%s/%s/%s, depending on hull size. Not as efficient as flux vents - most useful when added to a design that already carries the maximum possible number of vents.

shield_shunt.name: Shield Shunt
shield_shunt.desc: Removes the ship's shields. The external emitter nodes are replaced with reinforced plating, increasing the ship's armor by %s.

frontshield.name: Makeshift Shield Generator
frontshield.desc:
Installs a makeshift, inefficient shield generator on the ship. The shield emitter is locked in a forward-facing position and has a %s degree arc.

The shield generator draws much of its power from engines and reduces the ship's top speed by %s.
frontshield.short: Installs basic shields on shieldless ship. Reduces top speed.

missile_autoloader.name: Missile Autoloader
missile_autoloader.desc: <tooltip created in the script due to sections/other complexity>
missile_autoloader.short: Reloads missile weapons in small missile mounts

hardenedshieldemitter.name: Hardened Shields
hardenedshieldemitter.desc: Reduces the amount of damage taken by shields by %s. Also reduces the chance that shields will be pierced by EMP arcs from weapons like the Ion Beam.

hardened_subsystems.name: Hardened Subsystems
hardened_subsystems.desc:
Increases peak operating time for ships that suffer degraded performance from extended deployment by %s.

Also reduces the rate at which combat readiness degrades by %s.
hardened_subsystems.short: Increases peak time, CR degrades more slowly.

heavyarmor.name: Heavy Armor
heavyarmor.desc: Increases the ship's armor by %s/%s/%s/%s points, depending on hull size.

high_scatter_amp.name: High Scatter Amplifier
high_scatter_amp.desc: <tooltip created in the script due to sections>
high_scatter_amp.short: Reduces beam range; beams deal more damage and apply hard flux to shields.

pointdefenseai.name: Integrated Point Defense AI
pointdefenseai.desc: Gives all point-defense weapons the ability to identify - and ignore - decoy flares. In addition, all point-defense weapons get the best possible target leading, regardless of combat readiness, and all damage to missiles is increased by %s.
pointdefenseai.short: PD ignores decoy flares, improved target leading, more damage to missiles.

pdintegration.name: #Point Defense Integration
pdintegration.desc:
Reduces the ordnance point cost of small point-defense weapons by %s. The cost reduction only affects weapons that have PD capability as a feature of the weapon itself, and not when it's gained through other means such as from a hullmod.

In addition, all point-defense weapons deal %s more damage to all targets.
pdintegration.short: Reduces ordnance point cost of small PD weapons, increases all PD damage.

targetingunit.name: Integrated Targeting Unit
targetingunit.desc:
Extends the range of ballistic and energy weapons by %s/%s/%s/%s, depending on hull size. Can not work in conjunction with Dedicated Targeting Core.

Most combat ships install either an Integrated Targeting Unit or a Dedicated Targeting Core, with the exception of more specialized variants.
targetingunit.short: Increases weapon range, more so for larger ships.

nav_relay.name: Nav Relay
nav_relay.desc:
When deployed in combat, increases nav rating of your fleet by %s/%s/%s/%s, depending on this ship's hull size.

The total nav rating of your fleet increases the top speed of your deployed ships.
nav_relay.short: Increases top speed of deployed ships.

neural_interface.name: Neural Interface
neural_interface.desc:
Links the flagship with another ship, allowing both ships to %s at the same time. As with "transfer command", some skill effects - such as those increasing ammo capacity, or combat readiness - do not apply to the other ship.

Also enables rapid switching between the linked ships without using a shuttle pod. The transfer is instant if the combined deployment points of the ships are %s or less. The destination ship must not be under the command of an officer or an AI core.
neural_interface.short: Allows rapid switching between ships, resets system cooldown and adds a charge.

neural_integrator.name: Neural Integrator
neural_integrator.desc:
An augmented version of Neural Interface that works with automated ships by enabling direct control of all of the ship's systems via the link and allowing both ships to %s at the same time. As with "transfer command", some skill effects - such as those increasing ammo capacity, or combat readiness - do not apply to the other ship.

Also enables rapid switching between the linked ships without using a shuttle pod. The transfer is instant if the combined deployment points of the ships are %s or less. The destination ship must not be under the command of an officer or an AI core.

The complexity of the modifications increases the ship's deployment points and supply cost to recover from deployment by %s.
neural_integrator.short: Specialized Neural Interface for automated ships.

frontemitter.name: Shield Conversion - Front
frontemitter.desc: Locks the ship's omni-directional shield emitter to a front-facing position and extends its arc by %s. As with all frontal emitters, the shield will also deploy twice as quickly.
frontemitter.short: Converts omni shield to front, extends arc.

adaptiveshields.name: Shield Conversion - Omni
adaptiveshields.desc: Converts frontal shields to omni-directional. Reduces the shield's arc by %s.
adaptiveshields.short: Converts front shield to omni, reduces arc.

operations_center.name: Operations Center
operations_center.desc: Increases the command point recovery rate by %s when installed on the flagship.
operations_center.short: Increases command point recovery rate when on flagship.

phase_anchor.name: Phase Anchor
phase_anchor.desc:
Reduces the phase cloak's activation cost to %s. Increases the soft flux dissipation and weapon recharge rate by %s while phased.

When suffering critical damage that would otherwise destroy or disable the ship, able to initiate an emergency dive deep into p-space. The ship counts as retreated and will emerge into normal space when combat is over, suffering an additional penalty to combat readiness equal to %s its deployment cost. The ship must have enough combat readiness to cover this cost to initiate the dive.

Due to the immense distortions in p-space caused by such a maneuver, only one ship per battle - regardless of which side it's on - is able to perform it.
phase_anchor.short: Increases flux dissipation and weapon recharge while phased, emergency dive maneuver.

recovery_shuttles.name: Recovery Shuttles
recovery_shuttles.desc: Reduces the casualties suffered by fighter pilots by %s.

reinforcedhull.name: Reinforced Bulkheads
reinforcedhull.desc: Increases the ship's hull integrity by %s. If disabled, the ship will not break apart and is almost always recoverable after the battle.
reinforcedhull.short: Increases hull integrity; ship almost always recoverable if lost.

fluxbreakers.name: Resistant Flux Conduits
fluxbreakers.desc: Decreases the amount of EMP damage taken from weapons such as Ion Cannons by %s. Also increases the ship's flux dissipation rate while venting by %s.
fluxbreakers.short: Reduces EMP damage taken, improves venting speed.

safetyoverrides.name: Safety Overrides
safetyoverrides.desc:
Disabling safety protocols increases the ship's top speed in combat by %s/%s/%s (depending on ship size, with a corresponding increase in acceleration) and allows the zero-flux engine boost to take effect regardless of flux level. The flux dissipation rate, including that of additional vents, is increased by a factor of %s.

Reduces the peak performance time by a factor of %s, prevents the use of active venting, and drastically reduces weapon ranges past %s units.

Can not be installed on civilian or capital ships.
safetyoverrides.short: Drastic improvement in performance, much lower peak time.

stabilizedshieldemitter.name: Stabilized Shields
stabilizedshieldemitter.desc: Reduces the amount of soft flux raised shields generate per second by %s. Does not affect the hard flux generated as a result of shields taking damage.

unstable_injector.name: Unstable Injector
unstable_injector.desc:
Increases the ship's top speed in combat by %s/%s/%s/%s su/second, depending on hull size.

Interferes with weapons targeting and other vulnerable systems, reducing non-missile weapon range by %s and increasing the fighter replacement time by %s.

additional_berthing.name: Additional Berthing
additional_berthing.desc:
Increases maximum crew capacity by %s/%s/%s/%s, depending on hull size, or by %s, whichever is higher.

For civilian-grade hulls, also increases maintenance supply use by %s.

auxiliary_fuel_tanks.name: Auxiliary Fuel Tanks
auxiliary_fuel_tanks.desc:
Increases maximum fuel capacity by %s/%s/%s/%s, depending on hull size, or by %s, whichever is higher.

For civilian-grade hulls, also increases maintenance supply use by %s.

efficiency_overhaul.name: Efficiency Overhaul
efficiency_overhaul.desc:
Reduces supply use for maintenance, fuel use, and minimum crew required by %s.

Increases the combat readiness recovery and repair rates by %s. The per-day supply consumption for CR recovery is increased to account for the increased recovery rate, but the total supply cost remains the same.
efficiency_overhaul.short: Reduces ongoing costs and enables more deployments.

expanded_cargo_holds.name: Expanded Cargo Holds
expanded_cargo_holds.desc:
Increases maximum cargo capacity by %s/%s/%s/%s, depending on hull size, or by %s, whichever is higher.

For civilian-grade hulls, also increases maintenance supply use by %s.

insulatedengine.name: Insulated Engine Assembly
insulatedengine.desc:
Increases the durability of the ship's engines by %s, and the ship's hull integrity by %s.

The ship's sensor profile is also reduced by %s.
insulatedengine.short: Makes engines harder to disable, lowers sensor profile.

militarized_subsystems.name: Militarized Subsystems
militarized_subsystems.desc:
Removes the penalties from a civilian-grade hull, and increases maximum burn level by %s.

Increases minimum crew required by %s.
militarized_subsystems.short: Removes sensor penalties, increases maximum burn level, increases crew required.

solar_shielding.name: Solar Shielding
solar_shielding.desc:
Originally developed by Diktat engineers after spending cycles dealing with the unique conditions of the inner Askonia system. Decreases the effect operating in a solar corona has on combat readiness by %s; also has the same effect against storms in deep hyperspace.

In combat, reduces energy damage taken by %s.
solar_shielding.short: Reduces effect of being in corona and energy damage taken.

surveying_equipment.name: Surveying Equipment
surveying_equipment.desc: Reduces the heavy machinery and supplies required to perform surveys by %s/%s/%s/%s depending on hull size, down to a minimum of %s for each.

terminator_core.name: Terminator Core
terminator_core.desc: Gives all point-defense weapons the ability to identify - and ignore - decoy flares. In addition, all weapons get the best possible target leading, regardless of combat readiness, all damage to missiles and fighters is increased by %s, and beam weapon range is increased by %s units.

shared_flux_sink.name: Shared Flux Sink
shared_flux_sink.desc: Handles %s of the flux dissipation of all attached modules. If modules are lost during battle, the extra flux dissipation is redistributed among the remaining modules. Up to %s of this extra dissipation applies to hard flux.
shared_flux_sink.short: Flux/hard flux dissipation bonus as modules are lost.

stealth_minefield.name: Stealth Minefield
stealth_minefield.desc: Mines attack enemy ships during battle.
stealth_minefield.short: Mines attack enemy ships during battle.

stealth_minefield_lt.name: Stealth Minefield - Low Tech
stealth_minefield_lt.desc: Mines attack enemy ships during battle.
stealth_minefield_lt.short: Mines attack enemy ships during battle.

bdeck.name: B-Deck
bdeck.desc:
Once per combat, when the fighter replacement rate reaches %s, the fighter launch bays are switched over to operate from a "B-Deck".

Standby fighters are launched to rapidly bring the wings back up to full strength, and the fighter replacement rate is set to %s.
bdeck.short: Launches fresh wing once per combat and replenishes the replacement rate.

chassis_storage.name: Fighter Chassis Storage
chassis_storage.desc: Fighter replacement rate does not go down when fighters are lost.
chassis_storage.short: Fighter replacement rate does not go down.

shield_always_on.name: Shield Always On
shield_always_on.short: Forces shield to stay on. Hidden, doesn't need description or icon.

missile_reload.name: Missile Autoforge
missile_reload.desc: An autoforge inside the ship periodically fully reloads the magazines of all missile weapons.

shielded_holds.name: Shielded Cargo Holds
shielded_holds.desc: Commonly found on ships that can't always rely on shields to protect their cargo from cosmic radiation. Only a few tweaks are needed to have the shielding confound long-range cargo scans, reducing the probability of contraband being detected.
shielded_holds.short: Improves chance to avoid detection of contraband.

repair_gantry.name: Salvage Gantry
repair_gantry.desc: Increases the resources gained from salvaging abandoned stations, derelicts, floating hulks, and other such by %s/%s/%s/%s, depending on hull size. Only affects the recovery of common resources such as fuel and supplies, and not rare items like blueprints. In addition, %s of the bonus applies to post-battle salvage.

phasefield.name: Phase Field
phasefield.desc: The ship is able to run a low-grade phase field for extended periods of time, reducing its effective sensor profile by %s.

fluxshunt.name: Flux Shunt
fluxshunt.desc: Allows the ship to dissipate hard flux at %s of the normal rate while shields are on.
fluxshunt.short: Allows dissipation of hard flux while shields are up.

civgrade.name: Civilian-grade Hull
civgrade.desc: Increases sensor profile by %s. Reduces sensor strength by %s.
civgrade.short: Increases sensor profile, reduces sensor strength.

high_maintenance.name: High Maintenance
high_maintenance.desc: Increases the monthly maintenance supply cost by %s.

coherer.name: Energy Bolt Coherer
coherer.short: Increases base range of non-beam energy weapons.

design_compromises.name: Design Compromises
design_compromises.desc:
The ship's performance suffers from competing design priorities, with multiple bleeding-edge projects integrated too late in the design cycle.

The ship's flux dissipation and capacity, even the nominal base values, are reduced by %s.

The range of ballistic weapons is reduced by %s, the rate of fire of missile weapons is reduced by %s, and the flux generation of energy weapons is increased by %s.

On the plus side, extra nanoforge capacity can be brought online more easily, allowing the installation of a %s despite the ship already having a fighter bay, increasing the number of operational fighter bays to %s.
design_compromises.short: Reduces missile and ballistic weapon range, and flux dissipation / capacity.

tow_cable.name: Monofilament Tow Cable
tow_cable.desc:
Improves the maximum burn level of the slowest ship in the fleet by 1. Multiple tugs can not be used to speed up the same ship by more than 1.

Can not be used in combat.
tow_cable.short: Increases burn level of another ship.

drive_field_stabilizer.name: Drive Field Stabilizer
drive_field_stabilizer.desc:
Stabilizes the fleet's drive bubble, increasing the maximum burn of the fleet by %s. The effect of multiple stabilizers is cumulative.

Increases the ship's sensor profile by %s.

ground_support.name: Ground Support Package
ground_support.desc: Close support weapons and counter-measures for ground defenses. Increases the effective strength of planetary raids by %s, up to the total number of marines in the fleet.

advanced_ground_support.name: Advanced Ground Support
advanced_ground_support.desc: Close support weapons and counter-measures for ground defenses. Increases the effective strength of planetary raids by %s, up to the total number of marines in the fleet.

delicate.name: Delicate Machinery
delicate.desc:
The ship systems require excessive maintenance and do not stand up well under the rigours of prolonged engagements.

Increases the rate of in-combat CR decay after peak performance time runs out by %s.
delicate.short: Increases CR decay rate after peak time runs out.

hbi.name: Heavy Ballistics Integration
hbi.desc: Reduces the ordnance point cost of large ballistic weapons by %s.
hbi.short: Reduces ordnance point cost of large ballistic weapons.

vast_hangar.name: Vast Hangar
vast_hangar.desc:
The ship has a huge hangar and a commensurate small fleet of support craft.

The number of fighter bays added by Converted Hangar is increased by %s, and its performance matches that of a dedicated fighter bay - all of the penalties and modifiers, including those to the ship's deployment cost, are negated.
vast_hangar.short: Increases the effect of Converted Hangar and removes its penalties.

rugged.name: Rugged Construction
rugged.desc:
Reduces most negative effects of d-mods by %s. If disabled or destroyed in combat, the ship has a %s chance to avoid new d-mods, and is almost always recoverable after the battle.

In addition, the supply cost to recover from deployment - and to effect repairs if the ship is disabled - is reduced by %s.
rugged.short: Reduces impact of d-mods; ship almost always recoverable if lost.

automated.name: Automated Ship
automated.desc: This ship is fully automated, and does not require - and can not take on - any human crew.
automated.short: Does not require and can not support crew.

advancedcore.name: Advanced Targeting Core
advancedcore.desc:
Extends the range of ballistic and energy weapons by %s. The range of point-defense weapons is only extended by %s.

Precludes the installation of a Dedicated Targeting Core or an Integrated Targeting Unit.

supercomputer.name: Targeting Supercomputer
supercomputer.desc:
Extends the range of ballistic and energy weapons by %s. The range of point-defense weapons is only extended by %s.

Also increases target-leading accuracy and greatly increases in-combat sensor range.

high_frequency_attractor.name: High Volition Attractor
high_frequency_attractor.desc: An experimental modification allowing high-frequency motes to be warped in by the rift core on board the ship.

ablative_armor.name: Ablative Armor
ablative_armor.desc:
An ancient design intended to stop micro-meteorites through sheer volume of material in place, before the advent of "spaced" armor.

Reduces the effective armor strength for the damage reduction calculation to %s of its actual value. However, ships of this design tend to carry extremely heavy armor.

distributed_fire_control.name: Distributed Fire Control
distributed_fire_control.desc: Much of the damage that takes weapons offline is to external control runs and power conduits. This ship's weapons are engineered to operate more independently, reducing their exposure to damage by %s and reducing the EMP damage taken by the ship overall by %s.
distributed_fire_control.short: Increases weapon durability and reduces EMP damage taken.

converted_bay.name: Converted Cargo Bay
converted_bay.desc: This ship's cargo hold has been converted to house a pair of fighter bays. The improvised manufactory that produces fighter chassis is unreliable, and most components have minor defects. Fighter speed reduced by %s, and damage taken increased by %s.

andrada_mods.name: Special Modifications
andrada_mods.desc:
During an inspection of an early prototype, the Supreme Executor was heard to comment unfavorably on exposed conduits running along the passageways, and the danger these must pose to the brave and loyal crew under combat conditions. 

The new chief designer, a loyal officer appointed by the Supreme Executor himself, instructed the forge-programmers to make accommodations for the installation of special blast-proof insulated paneling produced by Sindria itself.

If the passages are a bit narrower, conduits prone to overheating, and flush-set panels somewhat unwieldy to access, the official readiness reports include no criticism of the changes. Everyone agrees in both public and - as the Internal Security Ministry can attest - in private, that the stark grandeur of the Lion's Guard fleet is breathtaking.

Crew casualties in combat are increased by %s. The base flux dissipation rate is reduced by %s, and the repair rate for disabled weapons and engines is reduced by %s.

vastbulk.name: Vast Bulk
vastbulk.desc: The main body of this structure is vast and is, for practical purposes, capable of absorbing any amount of damage from conventional weapons without being destroyed.

axialrotation.name: Axial Rotation
axialrotation.desc: This structure constantly rotates around its axis.

anchorrotation.name: Anchor Rotation
anchorrotation.desc: This structure rotates around its anchor attachment point. For station modules only.

always_detaches.name: Always Detaches
always_detaches.desc: Always detaches from parent structure when destroyed.

never_detaches.name: Never Detaches
never_detaches.desc: Never detaches from parent structure when destroyed.

no_weapon_flux.name: No Weapon Flux
no_weapon_flux.desc: Weapon fire costs no flux. Used on fighters for fine-grained control of effective shield hitpoints.

do_not_fire_through.name: Do Not Fire Through
do_not_fire_through.desc: Weapons on other modules of a station will avoid firing through this module, even though the shots would go over it and not hit.

shard_spawner.name: Shard Spawner
shard_spawner.desc: Spawns shard ships when ship is disabled/destroyed.

threat_hullmod.name: Threat Hull
threat_hullmod.desc: Hidden hullmod for managing the special properties of Threat ships. Description created in script.

fragment_swarm.name: Fragment Swarm
fragment_swarm.desc:
A swarm of Threat fragments roils around the ship, providing a regenerating supply of fragments for fragment-based weapons.

The base number of fragments is %s/%s/%s/%s, and replacement fragments are launched %s/%s/%s/%s times a second, depending on hull size.

This hullmod is required for fragment weapons to function, if the hullmod is not present or there are not enough fragments in the swarm, fragment weapons will be disabled.
fragment_swarm.short: A swarm of Threat fragments roils around the ship.

secondary_fabricator.name: Secondary Fabricator
secondary_fabricator.desc: Increases the rate at which replacement fragments are launched by %s.

fragment_coordinator.name: Fragment Coordinator
fragment_coordinator.desc: Increases the maximum number of fragments in the ship's fragment swarm by %s.
fragment_coordinator.short: Increases the size of the fragment swarm around the ship.

dweller_hullmod.name: Dweller Hullmod
dweller_hullmod.desc: Adds Shrouded Dweller visuals and any custom mechanics. Not visible to the player.

shrouded_mantle.name: Shrouded Mantle
shrouded_mantle.desc:
The ship will attempt to recoil (hopefully) away from danger when taking substantial hull damage.

Crew casualties in combat are increased by %s.
shrouded_mantle.short: The ship recoils away from damage.

shrouded_thunderhead.name: Shrouded Thunderhead
shrouded_thunderhead.short: The ship fires Rift Lightning bolts at recent targets of its weapons.

shrouded_lens.name: Shrouded Lens
shrouded_lens.short: The Lens automatically focuses on nearby targets, dealing damage in an area.

fourteenth.name: Fourteenth Battlegroup
fourteenth.desc: This ship is a survivor of the original 14th Domain Battlegroup which founded the Hegemony. It is a prime specimen of the Domain Navy's "decisive battle" doctrine, particularly exhibited by a series of radical structural modifications (performed with pre-Collapse industrial methods) which allow the mounting of heavier armor plating by a flat increase of %s standard units, with only a %s reduction in speed and maneuverability. Exceptionally well-tuned energy systems increase flux throughput and capacity by %s over standard examples of this hull.

heg_militarized.name: Militarized Hegemony Auxiliary
heg_militarized.desc: This ship is - or was - on the Hegemony auxiliary list. Uparmour kits applied at Hegemony Naval yards resulting in no loss of performance for a %s/%s/%s/%s increase in armor strength, depending on hull size. Core power systems have been upgraded to military standards resulting in a %s improvement in overall handling, %s increase in flux capacity, a %s increase in flux dissipation, and an increase of maximum burn level by %s.

comp_armor.name: Compromised Armor
comp_armor.desc:
This ship's armor has taken major and irreparable damage at some point in the past, or suffered from major errors in the manufacturing process. Armor rating reduced by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

comp_hull.name: Compromised Hull
comp_hull.desc:
This ship's hull has taken major and irreparable damage at some point in the past, or suffered from major errors in the manufacturing process. Hull integrity reduced by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

degraded_engines.name: Degraded Engines
degraded_engines.desc:
Whether due to battle damage, manufacturing defects, or cycles of poor maintenance, this ship's engines are suffering from permanently degraded combat performance. 

Top speed and maneuverability in combat reduced by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

degraded_drive_field.name: Degraded Drive Field
degraded_drive_field.desc:
Whether due to battle damage, manufacturing defects, or cycles of poor maintenance, this ship's drive field is suffering from permanently degraded performance. 

Maximum burn level decreased by %s. Sensor profile increased by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

faulty_grid.name: Faulty Power Grid
faulty_grid.desc:
Whether due to battle damage, manufacturing defects, or cycles of poor maintenance, this ship's power grid will never be capable of achieving peak performance.

Flux capacity reduced by %s. Flux dissipation rate reduced by %s. Sensor profile increased by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

unstable_coils.name: Phase Coil Instability
unstable_coils.desc:
The phase coils on this ship are impossible to calibrate properly due to subtle flaws. Reduces the phase-time bonus by %s, reduces the peak performance time by %s, and increases the rate at which combat readiness degrades by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

comp_structure.name: Structural Damage
comp_structure.desc:
This ship's hull has likely taken extreme damage in the past, possibly to the point of breaking apart. Armor rating reduced by %s, hull integrity reduced by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

glitched_sensors.name: Glitched Sensor Array
glitched_sensors.desc:
The ship's sensor array is damaged past any repair short of a complete hull overhaul. Weapon range in combat reduced by %s. Sensor strength reduced by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

malfunctioning_comms.name: Malfunctioning Comms
malfunctioning_comms.desc:
The comm system has suffered serious damage, making punching through battlefield jamming even more of a challenge. Fighter engagement range reduced by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

defective_manufactory.name: Defective Manufactory
defective_manufactory.desc:
The manufactory that produces fighter chassis is unreliable, and most components have minor defects. Fighter speed reduced by %s, and damage taken increased by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

damaged_deck.name: Damaged Flight Deck
damaged_deck.desc:
The flight decks on this ship have taken major damage and seriously interfere with normal operation. Time to launch replacement fighters is increased by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

fragile_subsystems.name: Unreliable Subsystems
fragile_subsystems.desc:
A widespread loss of redundant components reduces peak operating time by %s, and increases the rate at which combat readiness degrades by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

comp_storage.name: Compromised Storage
comp_storage.desc:
The storage capacity of this ship is significantly degraded. Crew, cargo, and fuel capacity reduced by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

increased_maintenance.name: Increased Maintenance
increased_maintenance.desc:
Increases the monthly maintenance supply cost by %s. Increases minimum crew required by %s. Decreases maximum combat readiness by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
increased_maintenance.short: Increases maintenance cost and crew requirements, decreases maximum combat readiness.

erratic_injector.name: Erratic Fuel Injector
erratic_injector.desc:
Increases fuel use by %s and decreases the zero-flux boost by %s su/second.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
erratic_injector.short: Increases fuel use and decreases the zero-flux boost.

faulty_auto.name: Faulty Automated Systems
faulty_auto.desc:
Increases minimum crew required by %s and decreases maximum combat readiness by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
faulty_auto.short: Increases minimum crew required, decreases maximum combat readiness.

damaged_mounts.name: Damaged Weapon Mounts
damaged_mounts.desc:
Reduces weapon turn rate by %s and increases recoil by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
damaged_mounts.short: Reduces weapon turn rate and increases recoil.

degraded_life_support.name: Degraded Life Support
degraded_life_support.desc:
Decreases maximum crew capacity by %s, and maximum combat readiness by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
degraded_life_support.short: Decreases maximum crew capacity and combat readiness.

degraded_shields.name: Degraded Shields
degraded_shields.desc:
Increases the amount of damage taken by shields by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

destroyed_mounts.name: Destroyed Weapon Mounts
destroyed_mounts.desc: Some of the original weapon mounts on this ship have been damaged beyond repair and can no longer be used.

ill_advised.name: Ill-Advised Modifications
ill_advised.desc: This hull's systems have been drastically modified from spec, likely without certified engineering oversight. Its systems appear to work correctly under routine conditions, but have a significant chance of critical malfunction when stressed.
